note: Recorded requirements for module ADM (hand-authored, see README).

requirements.title: Institution, course and district masters
requirements.description: The system shall allow the State administrator to maintain institution, course and district masters, with LGD codes for districts and a recognition flag for institutions.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an institution marked not recognised, when an applicant selects it, then the course eligibility rule BR-003 fails.

requirements.title: User and role management
requirements.description: The system shall allow the State administrator to create officer accounts and map each nodal officer to one institution and each District Social Welfare Officer to one district.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a nodal officer transferred, when their mapping is changed, then pending applications move to the new nodal officer of the institution.

requirements.title: Import of 2025-26 beneficiaries
requirements.description: The system shall import the list of 2025-26 beneficiaries as a master for renewal, with name, institution, course and bank details, and report records that fail validation.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an import file of 10,000 records, when imported, then accepted and rejected counts add up to 10,000 and rejected records are downloadable with reasons.

requirements.title: Scheme parameters
requirements.description: The system shall allow the State administrator to configure the income limit, attendance threshold and stage timelines as parameters with effective dates, without code changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a new income limit effective from a date, when an application submitted after that date is checked, then the new limit is applied.
